# Support

1. Read the guide: [English](../docs/guide.md) or [한국어](../docs/guide.ko.md), especially the troubleshooting section.
2. Run `scripts/check-proxy.sh` from the client that fails and include its output (it never prints your key).
3. Search existing issues, then open a new one. Never paste keys, tokens, IP addresses or account names.

Support is best effort.
